tagline: Standalone player with an on-device AI voice engine — music removed automatically
changelog: 100% Isolation is now the default: the Max preset applies the pure (hard) mask — everything the engine classifies as music is silenced completely, leaving only the human voice

New pure separation path at Max: a hard 115 Hz–9 kHz vocal band, a zero residual floor and a 0.35 logit gate — the sustained-instrument suppressor mutes drones and unchanging tones within about 2 seconds

Cover art: the artwork embedded in your files is now extracted and shown — ID3v2 APIC (MP3), FLAC PICTURE, M4A/MP4 covr (moov at the front or the end) and OGG METADATA_BLOCK_PICTURE — with a built-in artwork when a file carries none
Pinned playback notification: a persistent top-bar notification while a song plays — cover thumbnail, title and artist, play/pause, next/previous and a one-tap output switch
The notification keeps working with the app in the background, driven by a foreground media service (MediaSession + MediaStyle)

Stable playback on external speakers: fixed stuttering and cut-outs on Bluetooth and wired output with proper audio focus, a live audio-focus listener (pause on loss, resume on gain) and a wake lock during playback
Audio output routing: Auto / Loudspeaker / Earpiece / Bluetooth / Wired — the same selector in Settings and in the notification, with automatic fallback when a device disconnects
Bluetooth and headset state tracking: A2DP connect/disconnect, headset plug/unplug and noisy-cable events re-route correctly and never tear the player down mid-song
